recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work should be handled under a new Vocabulary decision only if the work group wants to redefine expansion-identifier uniqueness, repeatability, or cross-server equivalence semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-16442 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked that ValueSet.expansion.identifier be summarized as "Identifies the value set expansion (business identifier)" instead of only "Uniquely identifies this expansion", following the ValueSet.identifier wording pattern.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit a866e73f4bcbb0dcd4104e6fc9891f52368618d4 (SVN revision 14683), which changed the old ValueSet spreadsheet short text and added business-identifier wording to the definition. Later source refactors preserved the wording in the current structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml and ValueSet search-parameter bundle.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes valueset=ValueSet. The current element short and search parameter description both use the requested business-identifier wording. Nearby narrative still describes the identifier as uniquely identifying an expansion, which is consistent with the full definition and expansion identifier rules. Later FHIR-55363 was Resolved - No Change and confirms the server assigns one expansion identifier rather than requiring repeatability. Zulip discussions found during reconciliation describe the identifier as a business identifier and caution that it is not a cross-server equivalence guarantee.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative ValueSet source and related search parameter already implement the Jira request. Adding redundant prose would not change implementer understanding and would risk maintenance drift.
